Get ready for FALLENS!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 20 (Formerly, [[Pizza Party|Pizzeria]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Monkey''' is an enemy that only appears in [[Pizza Party]]. It has a large amount of health, below average speed and 50% defense, reducing most forms of damage to it by 33%. The '''Monkey''' also has [[Aggro]], forcing all towers with the '''Monkey''' in range to target it. ==Appearance== The '''Monkey''' is a cymbal-banging monkey toy. It has brown fur with pale goldenrod skin, a yellow coat with three red buttons and striped pants with a red and white pattern. It holds two cymbals, one in each hand, which it bangs as it walks on the path. ==Strategy== *The '''Monkey''' has the [[Aggro]] attribute, which means that towers will target it until it is either dead or out of range. **High DPS towers such as the [[Engineer]] or [[Minigunner]] can be used to quickly eliminate it. **Spreading out towers can help by having towers target a variety of enemies. **Towers with area of effect capabilities, like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Mortar]] or [[Golden Pyromancer]] can be used to damage both the '''Monkey''' and enemies around it. **Player controlled forms of damage, such as the [[Commando]] missiles, [[Gatling Gun]] or [[Military Base]]'s ''Airstrike'' can be used to target enemies other than the '''Monkey'''. *Units, like the [[Tank (Unit)|Tank]] or [[Riot Guard]], can be used to collide into enemies in front of it. **Do note that units are also affected by the [[Aggro]] attribute. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseMonkey.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} HalloweenPI3.jpg|'''Monkey''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Halloween Launch Trailer|'''Monkey''' in the game trailer. Tower Defense Simulator- Halloween 2022 Trailer|'''Monkey''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexMonkey.png|'''Monkey''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Monkey''' is based on the Musical Jolly Chimp toys. ==Update History== *'''31 October 2022''' - [[v1.4.2]] **'''Monkey''' added. *'''23 May 2023''' - [[v1.7.3]]a **[[Energy Immunity]] replaced with [[Stun Immunity]]. *'''22 January 2025''' - [[v1.50.0]] **Health changed from 250 to 800. **Speed decreased from Fast (6) to Below Average (2.5). **Defense of 50% added. **Now gives {{Money|800}} on death. **[[Aggro]] added. **[[Stun Immunity]] removed. **{{Bug}} Appears twice in the [[Index]], one of them not loading in any model for the preview. *'''29 January 2025''' - [[v1.51.0]] **Cash given increased from {{Money|800}} to {{Money|1,000}} upon death. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} No longer appears twice in the [[Index]]. {{PizzaParty|[[Knight]]|Wave 20|Monkey|Wave 21|[[Cobalt Guard]]|Wave 23}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Mid-Game]]
